quickAnswer.question: Is there an API to get TikTok transcripts?
quickAnswer.answer: TikTok does not offer an official API that returns the transcript of any public video. A TikTok transcript API such as TranscriptX fills that gap: send the video link and receive the spoken words as text with timestamps, in over 100 languages. Because the audio is transcribed, it works on videos without captions.

sections.h2: What Is a TikTok Transcript API?
content: A TikTok transcript API returns the spoken content of a TikTok video to your application. You pass the video URL; you get back the transcript as text or timed segments, ready to analyse, store or display.

TikTok is one of the biggest sources of what people are saying about products, trends and news — but almost all of it is locked inside short videos. A transcript API turns those videos into text that your code can search, classify and summarise.

sections.h2: Why TikTok Doesn't Give You Transcripts
content: TikTok's official developer APIs are built for specific approved use cases, and none of them simply returns the transcript of an arbitrary public video. Access requires an application and review, and the data you get is limited to what each programme allows.
Captions do not solve it either. Many creators never add them, auto-captions are not always switched on, and on-screen text is often stylised, partial or different from what is actually said.
That is why a TikTok transcript API works from the audio. TranscriptX listens to the video itself, so every public TikTok with speech returns text — whatever the creator did or did not caption.

TikTok audio is hard: fast talking, slang, trending sounds and music under the voice. TranscriptX separates speech from background music and noise before transcribing, and labels each speaker when a video has more than one voice — a duet, a stitch, a street interview.
Languages are detected automatically, so a mixed feed of English, Spanish, Indonesian and Vietnamese videos comes back as text in each original language, with no configuration per request.

items.q: Does TikTok have an official transcript API?
items.a: No. TikTok's developer APIs require approval for specific use cases and do not provide a simple way to get the transcript of any public video.

items.q: Does it work if the TikTok has no captions?
items.a: Yes. The transcript is generated from the audio, not from captions.

items.q: Do I need a TikTok account or developer approval?
items.a: No. You only need the public video link and a TranscriptX API key.

items.q: Can I get TikTok transcripts as subtitles?
items.a: Yes. Export the transcript as SRT or VTT.

items.q: Can I transcribe private TikTok videos?
items.a: No. Only public videos can be accessed.
